description: The preceding optional and its terminator lie inside another plain optional with a ranked group. Capturing c changes neither the blocker nor its logical parent. The written [T U] cannot complete in this span, so .matches(r) is true (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text $r:input
%conditions $r.matches(r)
%rule input B D T Z
%rule r :: Queried | B [[($c:c ≻ c)] [+T U] D T] Z
%rule c D
